verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents its own AI investigation surface, Canvas, which supports skills for investigations. Its official MCP server exposes Canvas investigation tools and is documented as letting agents investigate and diagnose latency or error spikes. The docs never explicitly describe the platform's AI being launched from a fired alert or producing a stated probable root cause, and Canvas evidence is thin. One community note that an earlier LLM latency analysis was only an internal demo predates these docs and does not concretely contradict them. Missing for 10: explicit alert- or error-triggered AI investigation, documented root-cause hypothesis output, in-depth Canvas docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have the platform's AI investigate an alert or error and propose a probable root cause

citations.quote: Use skills to add instructions or context to your Canvas investigations.
